purposes.seed: Repeatable inspection grain; never affects gameplay RNG.
purposes.edge_bevel_m: Small inward edge catches light inside the native envelope, half D1's arris.
purposes.joint_width_m: Four millimetre backed joints in timber fine pieces; no grooves on mineral/metal variants.
purposes.joint_depth_m: Three millimetre physical join depth leaves every fine face closed.
purposes.board_spacing_m: Keep the same quarter-metre board rhythm as coarse D1, not a squeezed full-size texture.
purposes.shelf_end_margin_m: Terminate recessed shelf joints 16 mm inside the front/back rim so its complete edge silhouette stays closed.
purposes.frame_rebate_m: A nine millimetre shoulder seats the infill within the original frame width.
purposes.frame_joint_m: Shallow two millimetre end joints show the assembly on front and back without opening a hole.
purposes.render_samples: Blender CPU inspection samples, not a game setting.
purposes.roughness: Matte provisional Blender timber; native engine family materials remain authoritative.
